notes.title: Madorica Real Estate 2 Release Date Revealed and Launch Discounts.
notes.notes:
Release Date Revealed and Launch Discounts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543956/e373d44ffebdc43fde9998ea3ea9d77fb292327c.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for waiting!
We are pleased to announce that "Madrica Real Estate 2 - The Mystery of New Property Floor Plans" will be available on February 8, 2023 (8am UTC).
We will also offer a 30% discount for one week as a launch discount, so please add it to your wishlist and don't miss it!
